args.body: Use the existing checkout mission and reuse any completed packet. Read the original seller terms using seller-document-navigation.json if committed. Locate the exact archive from EXISTING-PACKAGE-MARKETPLACE-CHECKOUT and use L369's clean-directory run only after confirming it describes those bytes. Verify each member's redistribution authority and rerun the documented learner command from a clean extraction. If supported, write one private EN/FR listing bound to the decoded archive hash, with AI disclosure, observed runtime requirements, a provisional price, documented fee and payout conditions, and the exact authorized activation step. If a prerequisite remains unresolved, identify the specific member, grant or seller condition that would reopen the route. Read back the actual evidence before closure under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep activation, sale, payout and Treasury settlement separate. Preserve independent review before any public release.

description: Treasury is unfunded and shows CAD 0 in verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available with zero classified events and five unclassified sources, so buyer demand remains unknown. The retrieved Lemon Squeezy activation and payout documents support preparing a private checkout packet for the existing SQLite exercise. Activation still depends on seller eligibility and authorization, and the packet depends on identifying the exact archive and its redistribution rights. The catalogue example has a nine-file dry run and an existing reviewer handoff. A qualifying approval for that exact digest is the trigger for publication through the host gate. Checkout preparation can proceed independently.
